questions.q: What does GRANTS_TO_USERS show when filtered to deleted_on IS NULL?
options: Every currently active (not revoked) role grant, by user
Every query that ever contained a GRANT statement
Only grants made by the ACCOUNTADMIN role
Only grants made in the last 24 hours
questions.explain: GRANTS_TO_USERS is a point-in-time view of grant state; deleted_on IS NULL isolates grants that haven't been revoked.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what is the key difference between INFORMATION_SCHEMA and ACCOUNT_USAGE?
options: INFORMATION_SCHEMA is near-real-time and scoped to one database with no history of dropped objects; ACCOUNT_USAGE is account-wide with up to a year of retained history, including dropped objects
INFORMATION_SCHEMA only exists on Enterprise Edition
ACCOUNT_USAGE cannot be queried with standard SQL
They are two names for the exact same schema
questions.explain: The scope, latency, and retention differ meaningfully — and only ACCOUNT_USAGE retains a record of objects after they're dropped.

questions.q: Why would an auditor query ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES instead of INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES to investigate a dropped table?
options: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES never shows a dropped table at all; ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES retains it with a DELETED timestamp
ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES is faster to query
INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES requires a different SQL syntax entirely
ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES only shows tables, never views
questions.explain: A dropped table disappears from INFORMATION_SCHEMA entirely, but ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES keeps the row with a DELETED timestamp — critical for after-the-fact investigation.

questions.q: What does the DELETED column on ACCOUNT_USAGE.TABLES contain for a table that still exists?
options: NULL
The current timestamp, refreshed on every query
The string 'ACTIVE'
The table's creation date
questions.explain: DELETED holds the timestamp the table was dropped; for a table that's still active, it's NULL.

questions.q: How does querying GRANTS_TO_USERS for current state differ from querying QUERY_HISTORY for GRANT statements (as in Lesson 20's dashboard tile)?
options: GRANTS_TO_USERS shows who currently holds a role; QUERY_HISTORY shows the history of grant events over time
They return identical results and either can be used interchangeably
GRANTS_TO_USERS only works for roles, never for warehouse privileges
QUERY_HISTORY cannot be filtered by query_type
questions.explain: One is a snapshot of current state; the other is an append-only log of when grants happened — different questions, different views.
